## TSS to Present at the 21st Annual Needham Technology, Media & Consumer Conference


May 8, 2026


GEORGETOWN, TX / ACCESS Newswire / May 8, 2026 / TSS, Inc. (Nasdaq:TSSI), a data center services company that integrates AI and other high-performance computing infrastructure and software and provides related data center services, is scheduled to present at the 21st Annual Needham Technology, Media & Consumer Conference on Thursday, May 14, 2026 at 10:15 a.m. Eastern Time. Investors may access a live audio webcast and replay at https://event.summitcast.com/view/aZxVFEntdXZooQDEsVx…
